# IQ Rest

> IQ Rest is a restaurant management platform that runs a whole venue from one app: a multilingual digital QR menu, a kitchen display, 24/7 table reservations and commission-free order taking. A restaurant goes live in about 5 minutes, with menus auto-translated into 35 languages by AI. Works on the web, iOS and Android. Used by 500+ restaurants, cafés and bars across 30+ countries.

## What IQ Rest is

- **Digital menu**: browser menu with photos, prices, allergens and descriptions, updated in real time from a phone. Guests scan a QR code at the table — no app to install. AI translates the menu into 35 languages so every guest reads it in their own.
- **Kitchen display**: orders appear live on a screen in the kitchen with notes and allergens; runs on any tablet or phone, no dedicated hardware required.
- **Table reservations**: guests book tables themselves 24/7 without phone calls; the restaurant manages availability from the dashboard.
- **Order taking** (secondary): guests order via the table QR code, or a waiter takes the order from a phone; tickets go straight to the kitchen or WhatsApp. 0% commission — every order goes directly to the restaurant.

## Pricing (modular, per restaurant)

Build-your-plan model: the digital menu is the base module, everything else is an add-on. EUR reference prices per month (monthly billing / cheaper rate when billed yearly):

- **Digital menu (base)**: €14.90 / month, or €9.90 / month billed yearly.
- **Table reservations (add-on)**: €9 / month, or €7 / month billed yearly.
- **Order taking + kitchen display (add-on)**: €13 / month, or €11 / month billed yearly.
- **Custom menu domain (add-on)**: €5 / month, or €4 / month billed yearly.
- **Volume discounts** for multiple restaurants on one account: 2–4 restaurants — 15% off monthly / 25% off yearly; 5+ — 25% off monthly / 50% off yearly.
- **Trial**: 14 days free, no credit card required. Cancel anytime. Prices are localised per country/currency; EUR shown here. See https://iq-rest.com/pricing for the interactive plan builder.

## Facts

- Product: IQ Rest (brand previously "SoqrMenu").
- Category: restaurant management / hospitality SaaS.
- Setup time: ~5 minutes.
- Languages: 35 (AI-translated menu).
- Platforms: web, iOS, Android.
- Site available in 35 languages; English is the default at the root, other locales under /<locale>/.

## Notes

- The product is not a food-delivery marketplace and takes 0% commission on orders.
- Localised pages exist for 35 languages with per-language URLs; see https://iq-rest.com/sitemap.xml.
